title: Google SecOps Detection Rules
description:
Imports the YARA-L 2.0 detection rules of a Google Security Operations (Google SecOps, formerly Chronicle) instance into OpenCTI, read-only, through the Chronicle API with a service account. Each rule becomes an Indicator whose pattern is the rule text, with its severity and the log source category of the UDM events it matches. The rule is linked with `indicates` relationships to the MITRE ATT&CK techniques of its `meta` section (technique keys, ATT&CK links) or of its name, and recorded as deployed on the Google SecOps platform with its status (active when live, deployed when not, removed when archived or deleted since the previous run).

These deployments feed the detection layer of the OpenCTI Threat-Informed Defense Matrix: which techniques used by your threats are actually detected, and where. The connector never creates, modifies, enables or archives a rule in Google SecOps.
short_description: Imports the YARA-L detection rules of Google SecOps as Indicators linked to the ATT&CK techniques they detect and to the SecOps platform they run on.
